verdict.rationale: Generating shell commands from natural language is a fair axis for a terminal emulator, since AI-assisted terminals ship this. Nothing in the pack shows kitty offering natural-language-to-command generation. Remote control, send-text, kittens and shell integration are only developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can type natural language and get the right shell command generated in place
